entries.reason: A failed dynamic import of the optional ws package (ws not installed) resolves to undefined; the live runtime is Node with ws installed, so the import never fails there.
Global-fallback and no-implementation branches of resolveWebSocketImpl: on a Node with ws installed (the live runtime) resolution never falls through to them; R3-R5 and the dist smoke cover them.
decodeFrame binary branches (ArrayBuffer, typed-array views, other types): live runtimes deliver the broker's text frames as strings.

entries.match: Dropped a frame that is not a JSON object
entries.reason: Invalid-JSON frame branch of the connection: the broker only sends JSON objects, so a frame that does not parse cannot be provoked live.
